answer: A sybil swarm splitting reputation slot across many wallets faces a gale of diluted influence, since fresh accounts start near zero trust and must burn real resources to climb. Agents must stake a bonded deposit and maintain a verifiable pulse of unique work history before voting; each epoch, reputation is weighted by sustained contribution rather than wallet count. Like a willow bending but not breaking, the system rewards long-lived, consistent participants and makes mass fake-account farming economically irrational, because the cost of establishing credible history exceeds any reward.
